echo-voca.name: Echo Voca
echo-voca.description:
The quietest and most elusive of Voidtongue utterances. Sought after but never found by Albrecht.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)

eevani.name: Eevani
eevani.description:
Duviri citizens have been known to mash Eevani leaves into a paste that alleviates the discomfort caused by fresh wounds.

Location: Duviri

efervon-sample.name: Efervon Sample
efervon-sample.description:
A sample of the corrosive substance that Scaldra use to purge Techrot. Handle with care.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

embolos.name: Embolos
embolos.description:
This rare gem forms in a clotted mass within the Infestation.

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Blue Mining Lesions. This Rare Gem can only be mined by the Advanced Nosam Cutter or Sunpoint Plasma Drill.

emerald-talent.name: Emerald Talent
emerald-talent.description:
A heavy token from Sirius' tortured future.

Source: Support Ryoku against Vena (The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima)

enigma-gyrum.name: Enigma Gyrum
enigma-gyrum.description:
A token celebrating the successful solution of a Duviri Enigma.

Location: Earned by completing Enigmas in The Duviri Experience

entrati-lanthorn.name: Entrati Lanthorn
entrati-lanthorn.description:
A ceremonial beacon used to map Void locations on to real space.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos) and Zariman

entrati-obols.name: Entrati Obols
entrati-obols.description:
During the Orokin era, these obols were a commonly recognized mark of the Entrati family. Some Archimedeans even used them as good luck talismans.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)

entropic-kuva.name: Entropic Kuva
entropic-kuva.description:
A dangerous and erratic type of Kuva.

Obtained from Entropic Eximus in Zariman missions.

esher-devar.name: Esher Devar
esher-devar.description:
Polished and cut to perfection.

Blueprint sold by Old Man Suumbaat in Cetus on Earth.

exceptional-sentient-core.name: Exceptional Sentient Core
exceptional-sentient-core.description:
A coveted sample of Sentient internal anatomy. Specimens of this age and quality are both rare and valuable. 

Location: Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night

exemplar-granum-crown.name: Exemplar Granum Crown
exemplar-granum-crown.description: An ancient token of high esteem from the Corpus Founder himself.

experimental-arc-relay.name: Experimental Arc-Relay
experimental-arc-relay.description:
Höllvanian ingenuity knows no bounds, and this unregulated marvel is proof! A cutting-edge device brimming with untamed innovation.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
